name: design-system-forge
description: Turns a single image, screenshot, mood board, or one small sentence into a complete, production-grade design system — tokens, components, all states, light/dark, plus an art-directed documentation shell. Five verbs: build, audit, study, redesign, audit-kit. Includes a creativity dial (safe to experimental), a sourced anti-generic standard (checked against Anthropic's and Google Material Design 3's live artifacts, with an honest note on where a third source had nothing citable), a thirteen-item AI-Slop Ledger, and a motion system (timing hierarchy, easing vocabulary, purpose tags, build recipes) so nothing ships static.
